======================================================
 Saud Ansari @ Sahud Ansari, son of Saukat Ansari @ Md. Shaukat Ali  Residence of Surendra Colony, Ward No. 11 Koilwar, P. S. - Koilwar, Dis  Bhojpur  ... ...
P  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Rajiya Khatoon, wife of Saud Ansari, D/o- Manjar Kalimullah Village-  Barahbatara Ps- Ara Town Dist- Bhojpur  ... ...

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Navin Kumar Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ajay Kumar No. 2, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 11-09-2024
Present learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present case has been filed by the opposite party no.2/ complainant who is the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is ready and willing to keep his wife with dignity.

03. Under the aforesaid circumstances, issue notice to the opposite party no.2/ complainant by both modes i.e., under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process for which requisites etc.
must be filed within two weeks failing which the Patna High Court CR.
dt.11-09-2024 petition will be dismissed.
04. Till next date of hearing, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner.
